subject.title: refactor(state): move device identity into canonical SQLite state

question: Should this release accept the one-way, Doctor-gated device-identity cutover for all processes sharing an OpenClaw state directory?
rationale: The proposed behavior deliberately changes downgrade and recovery semantics for persisted authentication identity; code review cannot decide whether the coordinated-upgrade requirement is acceptable for the release.

options.title: Accept the coordinated cutover
options.body: Approve the canonical SQLite-only identity path with the documented requirement to keep processes sharing a state directory on aligned versions.

options.title: Require upgrade-path sign-off
options.body: Require release-owner confirmation that a v2026.7.1 legacy JSON install preserves its identity after Doctor migration and presents an actionable recovery path before merge.

options.title: Defer the cutover
options.body: Pause the PR until the release can support a less disruptive migration or explicitly managed downgrade path.

recommendation.title: Require upgrade-path sign-off
recommendation.body: Require release-owner confirmation that a v2026.7.1 legacy JSON install preserves its identity after Doctor migration and presents an actionable recovery path before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied commit history shows this contributor driving the implementation and its cross-runtime migration hardening.
